label: UZH-FPV
title: UZH-FPV
intro: The camera–IMU calibration bags of the UZH-FPV Drone Racing dataset: an mDAVIS346 and a Snapdragon Flight, each recorded indoors and outdoors, at 45° and facing forward. A one-off study, not part of the leaderboard batch or the regression suite.

image.alt: MVIS solving a UZH-FPV Davis bag: board, camera path and one camera frame
image.credit: MVIS solve view, from the homepage

reading: IMU weights. All three tools use IMU sigmas taken from the residuals in UZH's own Kalibr results, not the MVIS defaults. The example page explains how they are derived.

One Basalt solve is left out. On davis_indoor_forward with these weights, Basalt gives a 120 mm lever and an accel scale (accelerometer scale factor) of 0.84. So its Davis column has 3 of 4 bags. At Basalt's default noise that bag is plausible, but snapdragon_indoor_45 then fails with a broken spline.

Basalt's Davis distance stands out. Its camera-to-IMU distance is 33.6 mm. Kalibr gives 23.2 mm and MVIS 22.8 mm on the same 3 bags. We haven't established why. At default noise Basalt's lever z is 14–25 mm.
Each device's 4 bags form one family, because the camera and IMU are on the same device. That assumes the camera–IMU geometry stayed the same across recordings, which we can't confirm.
Snapdragon's time offset really does differ between bags, with an sd (standard deviation) near 4.7 ms in every tool. So a small difference between tools on that row says little about each bag.
no_repeatability: This study has no repeatability cells: it was made before the current schema, and 4 bags per device are too few for the test (it needs 6).

families.title: mDAVIS346 + IMU
families.read_first: All three tools use each bag's IMU weights from the residuals in UZH's own Kalibr results. Kalibr's intrinsics and baseline are inputs from the calibration UZH ships.
notes: Every tool starts from the camera chain UZH ships and uses the same IMU sigmas on the same bags. Kalibr keeps the camera values fixed; MVIS and Basalt refine them.
Basalt has 3 of 4 recordings: its davis_indoor_forward solve failed (lever 120 mm, accel scale 0.84) and is left out.
